description: Issue #195: `integration_baseline` written as a bare string is refused, not wrapped. The accepted shape is `baseline`'s — an array of strings — because both fields are "commands to run, in this order" and a profile whose two verification lists disagreed about what a command is would refuse one and accept the other for the same text. Coercing a lone string into a one-element array is the tempting alternative and is worse than it looks: `"npm run lint && npm test"` would become one command run through whitespace splitting (the runner does not use a shell), so the profile would quietly measure `npm` with the wrong argv instead of running two steps. Refused at profile load, before an issue is read: `load_error` / exit 6, the code every other malformed profile field exits with, so the message sends the reader to the file they can fix.

error_details_include: profile.integration_baseline must be an array of strings
